description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the complete Steering Knuckle & Steering Knuckle Rebuild Kit for RH Side.
Passenger Side (RH)
Get everything you need to completely rebuild your Passenger Side Front-End Knuckle.
Includes OEM Knuckle Assembly
Comes with King Pins & Bearings!
Comes with Felt & Oil Seal!
COMPLETE RH SIDE!
Direct Replacement
NOTE: Color of Oil Seal may vary
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Steering Knuckle Assembly
Qty 2 – King Pins
Qty 2 – King Pin Bearings
Qty 2 – Shims for King Pins
Qty 1 – Steering Knuckle Oil Seal
Qty 1 – Steering Knuckle Felt
Qty 2 – Retainer Plates, Knuckle Oil Seal
Qty 2 – Cover Plates, Knuckle Oil Seal
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
